shared_elements: human-derived form (a face/figure in A; possible weathered anthropomorphic shapes and inscribed signs in B)
justification: A depicts a three-dimensional standing anthropomorphic figure with a large modelled face, brow, nose and clasped arms, while B shows a flat cliff face carved with horizontal registers of small incised signs and no comparable figural motif. The only shared content is the very generic presence of human-related carving on stone, which any tradition could produce independently; there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement.
